diagnostics.message: :resource.time_sleep.wait_30_seconds waits only for role creation, so its delay can expire before :resource.aws_iam_role_policy.splunk_integration finishes attaching the integration's inventory permissions. Add this policy to the timer's depends_on so the downstream enabled Splunk integration starts only after policy creation and the intended propagation delay.

:resource.time_sleep.wait_30_seconds does not wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy.splunk_managed_policy. The downstream integration enables use_metric_streams_sync, which requires the CloudWatch Metric Streams and iam:PassRole permissions supplied by this policy. Add this policy to the timer's depends_on so its propagation delay begins after those permissions are attached.
